thread:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up — cross-region TLS retries are still showing small spikes in prod. Linking postmortem: https://redwood/products/postmortem/CR-TLS-2026
Sergio: looking. are these traffic e2e retries or client replays?
Maya: mostly LB->egress TLS handshake failures, then retry routing to secondary region. causes brief 5xx spikes. see logs snippet:
```
May 02 03:12:11 lb-01 tls: handshk: alert timeout
May 02 03:12:11 route: failover -> eu-west-1
May 02 03:12:11 request_id=abc123 status=502
```
Li Chen: suggested action from PM: pin cert chain order + increase retry-backoff in router.
Ops Sam: I'll own the router config change. ETA EOD tomorrow (2026-05-03). will create PR.
Net Eng Jess: need DNS TTL change too? we saw some clients re-resolve causing cross-region flapping.
Maya: yes, reduce TTL to 30s for affected LB records for 48h. @Ops Sam can you coordinate with DNS?
Ops Sam: will open ticket with registrar, ETA 6 hours. ticket: https://redwood/tickets/INC-1428
Sergio: also adding a canary: route 1% traffic to updated router for 2h then increase.
Li Chen: runbook updates: add detection play: "5xx > 0.5% AND cross-region ejections > 3 in 1m" -> trigger oncall page.
oncall-bot: [alert-rule] created: cross-region-ejects-threshold
Net Eng Jess: I'll take ownership for postmortem action item on certificate chain validation (owner: jess, due: 2026-05-10)
Maya: added timeline to tracking doc and linked PRs. quick check-in tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Sergio: noted. can we add retrospective metric for "retry-to-success ratio"? helps measure regressions.
Li Chen: good call — I'll add to Optimize dashboards.
Maya: thanks all — closing thread after tomorrow's check-in.
